title: MashRankSwitcher
description: A plugin which makes it easy for your staffs or creators to change their ranks anytime they want!
body:
> # 🐦MashRankSwitcher🎮

A simple lightweight plugin that allows your server staff and content creators to instantly toggle their privileged ranks on or off with a single command. It's the perfect solution for seamless testing, discreet interaction, or focused content creation. Great for servers that value discretion, content quality, and accurate testing of the player experience.

> ## 🥥Features🦅
- Super lightweight.
- Fully configurable.
- Easy to use.
- Easy to configure.
- Easy to setup.

> ## 👀Key Features & Benefits🥐
- 🚀 Instant Rank Toggle
  Staff or creators can remove all configured ranks with one command, instantly going "undercover".
- 🎯 Precise Rank Control
  Only ranks with the "mashrankswitcher.toswitch" (configurable in config) permission are affected.
- 💻 Full Admin Oversight
- Admins can manually switch ranks for any online player. They can also see all switched players!
- ✅ Reliable Data Storage
  Ranks are safely saved using UUID or Username, ensuring perfect restoration every time.

![A list containing all rankswitched users.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/yp5B1m3O/images/ac4560d4795ce94c2dcc279c83faf766631d6c25.png)

> ## 🌮Requirements⚙
1. LuckPerms:
   This plugin highly depends on Luckperms to work.
2. PlaceholderAPI:
   PlaceholderAPI is required for few of the options to work.

   

> ## 🤵How It Works 👀
1. 🎟Preparation (Admin Setup):
   Grant the required permission, "mashrankswitcher.toswitch", to the staff ranks you want your team to be able to temporarily remove (e.g., Builder, Moderator, Content Creator). Only groups with this permission will be affected.
2. 🌮Activation (Player Action):
   A player runs the command "/rankswitch". The plugin saves a snapshot of their current groups and then immediately removes any group associated with the "mashrankswitcher.toswitch" permission.
3. 🐇Deactivation (Player Action):
   When the player is ready to return to their role, they run "/rankswitch" again. The plugin uses the saved snapshot to restore every single removed group, putting them back in their exact original state.
